call_points.text: Consolidated EBITDA margin can be maintained in the high teens, management said.
Net debt to equity is 0.2x and management does not expect to go up to 1x.
Commodity cost pass-through has a one-quarter lag; management expects normalisation this quarter.
Antolin interiors margin improved from 7%-8% to early teens and management hopes for mid-teens.
Manufacturing volumes grew 12-14% and SPR grew over 16%, outgrowing the industry.
Takahata phase-four expansion has started; new business revenue expected early next year.
EMFi doubled sales last year after commissioning the Coimbatore capacity in December; full-year benefit expected now.
Net debt was about ₹550 Cr as of June 2026.
Fundraise is progressing as per target; use between acquisitions and debt repayment not split.
Exports to Europe, the US and the Middle East remain weak and have not recovered.
Management declined to give segment revenue/EBITDA break-up or wage-cost impact for the quarter.
The company is planning a QIP of INR 1,000 crores to fund future organic and inorganic growth.

operating_notes.text: Powertrain agnostic businesses contributed around 35% of consolidated total income during the quarter.
Powertrain-agnostic businesses contribute over 35% of consolidated total income, and about 60% of the business is positioned as insulated from EV penetration.
Antolin interiors EBITDA margin improved from 7%-8% to early teens after fixed-cost actions and synergies.
Net debt was about ₹550 Cr as of June 2026, with net debt to equity at 0.2x.
H1FY27 operating cash flow was ₹198.1 Cr and capex was ₹144.2 Cr.
Consolidated total income grew 60.6% YoY in Q2FY27 driven by organic growth and acquired entities.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,455.8 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹156.3 Cr.
SPR Auto Technologies held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 12, 2026.
Shareholders approved Mr. Arun Kumar Shukla’s appointment as Director for five years (Aug 4, 2026–Aug 3, 2031) via postal ballot with 96.61% votes in favor.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,648.2 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹158.5 Cr.
SPR Auto Technologies held its Q2 & H1 FY27 earnings investor presentation showing consolidated total income up 60.6% YoY to ₹1,674.6 Cr.

watchlist.text: Shareholder and regulatory approvals for QIP fund raising
Shareholder approval for final dividend at AGM
Shareholder approval for re-appointment of directors

watchlist.response: The QIP is for funding organic and inorganic growth options.
watchlist.text: Reason for raising INR 1,000 crores via QIP given low debt-to-equity ratio.

watchlist.response: Management attributed it to commodity cost lag, product mix and first-quarter seasonality, without quantifying each.
watchlist.text: Analysts pressed on why standalone EBITDA margin fell about 200 bps sequentially despite gross margin rising 60 bps.

watchlist.response: Management declined, saying it does not give quarterly break-ups and pointing to last year's annual break-up.
watchlist.text: Analysts asked for segment-wise revenue and EBITDA for plastics, Antolin and EMFi.

watchlist.response: Management said money is fungible and gave no split.
watchlist.text: Analysts asked how much of the ₹1,000 Cr fundraise goes to acquisitions versus debt repayment.

watchlist.response: Management declined to give internal figures.
watchlist.text: Analysts asked for the wage-hike impact on the quarter's employee cost.
